title: Two Plans for a Safer High Street · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: The town of Millbrook has one busy high street. Cars go fast, and many people want a safer road. Last month, the town council showed two plans. Plan A is called 'Slow Street'. Plan B is called 'Bus First'. People can read both plans online and send ideas before 30 June. Plan A is cheaper than Plan B. It costs about £40,000. Workers will put three new zebra crossings near the school and the market. They will also build two small gardens with trees and benches. The speed limit will go down from 30 mph to 20 mph. Plan A is slower than Plan B for cars, but it is safer for children and older people. The council says the work will take six weeks. In Plan A, buses will stop at the same places as today. Plan B is more expensive. It costs about £120,000.
